title: Elevators Into Escalators
content: Last night, I had a Mall World dream I wanted to share because although it isn’t as interesting as others I’ve had or seen posted here, it is one I now realize I’ve had before in some variation. I started off in a store but left with my two sisters to find a bathroom. We took an escalator through a dark area of the building, were let out through a chute of sorts, and were immediately in front of an elevator. I pressed the button to call the elevator, and when it arrived, I got in with one sister and tried to press the button for the 2nd floor(we were in a basement) but I must have hit the close doors button because suddenly the doors closed and the elevator moved upward. I called out to my sister to meet us on the 2nd floor, but the elevator stopped at the first floor and we had to get out because others were streaming in. My sister and I frantically went through a dark part of the building on some sort of ramp looking for stairs to the second floor. The dream ended. When I awoke, I realized I’ve had many of these types of dreams in mallworld where I’m desperately trying to get somewhere on elevators that don’t go where they are supposed to, I’ve had one in an elaborate golden high rise hotel for example. Anyone else relate to these?
